remarks: Welcome to Glenview Terrace, conveniently located garden style condo community in desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. This sunny 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath top floor one level unit with garden views has been tastefully updated throughout. Featuring open concept living room dining area with hardwood floors and oversized sliders leading to a private balcony with courtyard views. Updated kitchen with white cabinets, granite counters and stainless steel appliances. Cozy renovated powder room, full size washer and dryer in unit, updated main bath and raised panel doors throughout. Oversized (10 x 20) private storage room in basement, one reserved parking space & plenty of visitor parking for 2nd car. Complex has beautiful pool & playground. Only minutes away from downtown and just 0.4 miles away from Glenbrook train station. AGENTS PLEASE READ AGENT REMARKS REGARDING APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS!
